instruction: AI Fine-tuning aur Pre-training me kya farq hai?
output: Pre-training me AI ko scratch se poori duniya ki knowledge di jati hai (isme mahino lagte hain). Fine-tuning me ek pehle se trained AI ko kisi specific task (jaise coding ya chat) ke liye thoda aur train kiya jata hai.
